record.title: Repeat the stock post-store witness with all live threads observed
record.intent: Verify that wider thread observation preserves the known stock device-to-state transition.
requirements: Fresh pinned guest, unchanged stock artifacts and established narrow admission controls.
Establish converged thread coverage while the device path is absent, then resume all siblings normally.
Preserve original open and 16 MiB mmap request evidence and exactly the established two main-thread mapped read responses.
Use continuous execution after the second read to the hardware stop at stock ELF 0x42a8f0.
Observe mapped faults from any traced thread; stop on unsupported access rather than supplying another value.
Record runtime clone/exit events and terminal pending stops, then quiesce and fully reap the traced group.
acceptance: Either verify the stock global value, x8/x9, instruction binding and actual breakpoint at the expected post-store boundary or classify the precise negative outcome.
Verify all thread identities and preservation evidence without claiming global hardware ordering or a physical instrument value.
